grammar.summary: 本课学习宾语从句中疑问语序的转化与 ask/wonder。

points.title: 间接疑问句
points.explanation: 直接引语 Am I all right? → He asked if he was all right. 三步转换：加 if、语序改陈述、时态回移。

examples.en: He asked whether Mr. Gilbert's operation had been successful.
examples.cn: 他问 Gilbert 先生的手术是否成功。

points.title: relieve 表放心
points.explanation: be relieved 表"松了口气"的状态：He was relieved. 医患对话场景高频。

examples.en: The doctor told him to stay in bed for another two days.
